text_block_list.text:
Starting today is the "Summer Training Camp"—
Special Week is also full of motivation.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer,
what should we start with!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Swimming? Sand sprints? All-you-can-eat?
Bring it all on!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I want to push further ahead at this training camp!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Gotta keep trainin' harder and harder
for the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No matter how strict it gets, I won't whine!
Trainer, I'm in your hands!
choice_data_list: Let's make this a fruitful training camp!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Please watch me. I'll definitely become stronger!"

—The final summer training camp
with Special Week has begun!
